subtasks.description: Implement Thevenin voltage (Vth) calculation - calculate open-circuit voltage between two terminals of a circuit
Implement Thevenin/Norton resistance (Rth) calculation for circuits with independent sources
Implement equivalent resistance calculation for circuits with dependent sources using test source method
Implement Norton current (In) calculation from Vth and Rth
Add visualization support for Thevenin and Norton equivalent circuits
Integrate Thevenin/Norton equivalent circuit feature into main circuit analysis API
Add unit tests for Thevenin and Norton equivalent circuit calculations

deferred_work: All 7 subtasks will be deferred to future runs. This feature requires careful implementation of open-circuit voltage calculation, equivalent resistance with support for both independent and dependent sources, Norton current derivation, visualization capabilities, and proper API integration.
